description: A room's tasks: title, notes, status (open, doing, done), ready, assignee, due, priority (low, normal, high, urgent), links, and the channel that made one. ready=true gives only the ones waiting to be taken. -- MakeHybrid API plan, GET /rooms/{id}/tasks, group rooms.

id.description: Value for the {id} segment of /rooms/{id}/tasks. Required; pass it raw (it is URL-escaped for you).

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
